title: A Murder in Portrait
summary: An artist is found poisoned in her studio. All of the possible suspects were outside having lunch.
method: The artist was only unconscious when the body was found, when the paint thinner in her studio was replaced with chloroform. The murder was committed by the person who discovered the body, when everyone else went for help. The killer put cyanide into the victim's mouth and also in the open energy drink.
motive: The killer had a gallery and was threatened at how the victim seemed to monopolize someone she saw as the next big artist.
killer: The girlfriend of the victim's assistant
